title: Burma Superstar Chicken Dal Curry
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.

ruled_substitutions.from: 2 1/2 lbs (8) bone-in chicken thighs, skin removed
ruled_substitutions.to: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh, 28 thighs (2800 g)
ruled_substitutions.basis: Established estate precedent: chicken-provencal and korean-braised-chicken-potatoes-dakdoritang both rebuilt bone-in-thigh sources onto the Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh item at the densities each=100 g weight (provencal: 8 bone-in thighs x 3.5 = 28 -> 2800 g, the identical shape to this recipe). The spec engine drives cost AND macros from one grams number, so bone-in purchase grams would corrupt macros with ~30% inedible bone; the estate's answer is the substitution, not a bone-in DB row. Yield check: source 1134 g bone-in skin-on at the USDA ~70% meat yield after bone and skin is ~800 g meat = 8 x 100 g, so the substitution preserves the source's actual meat quantity.

macro_cross_check.verdict: EXPLAINED, NOT A PORTION ERROR - the gap exceeds 15% so the main protein line was re-examined per rule 6, and the source's own numbers are arithmetically reproduced by one identifiable calculator mistake ON THEIR SIDE: booking the full 2.5 lb BONE-IN weight as edible boneless meat. 1134 g x USDA thigh meat-only raw (19.7 P/100 g) = 55.9 g protein/serving, + peas 6.0 + aromatics ~2 = ~64 g - exactly their published 64. Calories reproduce the same way (1134 x 1.19 = 337/serving from chicken + peas 84 + oil 30 + onion 40 + garlic 15 + spices ~10 = ~516 vs their 529). A 142 g bone-in thigh cannot physically yield the 145 g of pure meat their figure requires. Our side is weight-anchored, not each-assumed: 8 thighs x the estate's 100 g BS weight = the source's own 1134 g bone-in at the ~70% USDA meat yield, and 200 g BS thigh/serving sits ABOVE the catalog's 167 g chicken average - the anti-florentine direction. Adjusting our grams upward to match their label would bake their refuse error into a published card.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 427 cal in [400, 650] PASS (floor margin 27 cal - see loud flag); carbs 28.5 g <= 35 PASS. Optional garnish lines (cilantro + lime + chiles) add ~7.6 cal / 2.4 g C per serving if the card counts them: 435 cal / 30.9 C, still PASS both.

loud_flags: CALORIE FLOOR MARGIN: recomputed 427 cal/serving is only 27 cal above the run's 400 floor. Any downstream trim (smaller thighs, oil reduction, dropping the discarded-ginger calories) risks a band failure at audit. The source's 529 headline is inflated by its own bone-in arithmetic (see macro_cross_check) and must not be relied on for the gate.
